tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zla gsang gzhi bsnyen las/ don grub bsnyen pa'i bsdebs dang ma grub na ar la gtad pa ru khug gi las shin tu gsang ba bzhugs so//

na mo ya mānta kā ya/ zla gsang gzhi bsnyen la grangs thems kyang rtags med na bya ba ni gnyis/ sngags bsdebs dang ar gtad ru khug go// dang po bsnyen pa'i tshe sngags 'bum phrag drug skyon med du thems kyang grub rtags ma byung na lcags sdig glo ba gangs ri dkar po las chad pa'i chos sde lag len don bsdebs chen mo las/ dang po yi dam khug tu gzhug pa ni/ oṃ oṃ oṃ ka pa ma ya li= mu ka ye nan dzaḥhriṃ hrīṃ/ zhes sam/ yang man ngag snying gzer nag po las/ oṃ oṃ oṃ ka pa ma ya= mu ka ye nan dzaḥhriṃ hrīṃ/ zhes sdeb bo// gnyis pa nye bar bsnyen pa'i skabs sngags 'bum phrag gsum thems kyang rtags med na/ lcags sdig don bsdebs las bsnyen pa dngos kyi sdeb ni/ oṃ nṛ badzra= dza la dza la/ sa ma ya/ a a aḥ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes sam/ yang na snying gzer las bsnyen pa'i sdeb/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadzra= sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ a a aḥ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ zhes bsdebs la bzlas/ des kyang rtags med na stod dkrug /oṃ a ka kro ya te mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags kyi sbyor ba byas la bzlas pas rtags mi 'byung mi srid do// gsum pa sgrub pa chen po'i skabs sngags 'bum phrag gcig thems kyang rtags ma mthong na lcags sdig don bsdebs las dam bsre/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ sa ma ya dzaḥr a nṛ tha pū dza siddhi kha graṃ nan tsa tsa ya hūm̐ nan a/ zhes sam/ yang na snying gzer las/ sa ma ya badzra a mṛ ta= pū dza siddhi hūm̐ utstsha ya nan a/ zhes rtags ma byung bar du bzla/ rtags byung nas lcags sdig don bsdebs las gnyis med bstim pa ni/ oṃ hrī ti a oṃ= a mo gha dzaḥbadzra hūm̐/ zhes sam/ snying gzer las/ i i i hrī ti ā= badzra ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes bzlas/ rtags mthong ma thag dngos grub blang ngo*// bzhi pa 'chi bdag bdud sgrub kyi tshe/ sngags 'bum phrag gcig thems kyang dregs pa 'du ba'i rtags med na lcags sdigs don bsdebs las/

dbang du bya ba ni/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ma ya= dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ ri li ri li/ zhes sam/ yang na snying gzer las/ sa ma ya ha ra= dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ ma ma ma/ zhes rtags ma byung bar du bzla'o// de ltar bsnyen sgrub bzhi po sngags grangs skyon med du thems shing sngags bsdebs byas kyang rtags med na/ rang nyid la dam tshig nyams chag yod pa'i rtags yin pas bshags sdom bya/ dge 'dun la ston mo drang*/ gsung rab bsgrag /sātstsha gdab/ mtshan brjod 'don/ tshogs 'khor rgya cher bya/ na raka 'don/ spong dag bya/ de rjes lcags sdig don bsdebs las bshags pa'i bsdebs ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya btags/ yang na snying gzer/ ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya btags la sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags mtshan ma gsal ba ma mthong gi bar du bzla'o// sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags gcig mthong nas slar gzhi bsnyen bskyar la bya'o// sngags bsdebs grangs nges pa med do/ rtags ma byung bar du 'bad pa yin no// yang de ltar gzhi bsnyen zhi drag grangs thems shing sngags bsdebs dang bshags pa'i bsdebs sogs gang byas kyang rtags med na/ yi dam ar la gtad pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa 'di bya ste/ the rar phanyoṃ shartha zathar dyi has sha khanatha mazi shar zathi kharukarene/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭ mu ka ye/ a pa ye/ ka pa ye a ā nai hrīḥṣṭī bi kṛ ta ya= ar la gtad pa rnam pa gnyis// las rnams byed pa gdon mi za// de nas/ gser gyi thog brgyad mtshan ma byung*// de nas yang ni sbyor ba brtsam// gshin rje'i gshed gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ ar la gtad pa'i le'u brgyad pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ ar gtad kyis rtags nges can ma byung bar du bzlas nas/ de ma thag zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi sgrub pa chen po byas la dngos grub blang*/ de rjes bskang bshags la 'bad cing slar 'chi bdag bdud sgrub bya'o// ar gtad 'di mi bya ka med la thug na ma gtogs gang rung du mi bya shin tu bka' gnyan pas gsang zhing sba bar bya dgos so// yang 'chi bdag bdud sgrub kyi tshe dregs pa 'du ba/

dbang du ma 'dus shing las la ma tshud pa'i rtags byung na ru khug drag pos bcug pa ni/ gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ru khug las 'di gsungs so// lha srin bar gcod byung gyur nas// khug tu gzhug pa'i las 'di bstan/ a kro sa ma ya mañdzu shrī ya ma rā dza a kro te ka ya mānta ka hrīḥṣṭi bi kṛ mu ka ye/ a pa ye/ ka pa ye/ ū ne u ne u ne/ u u u/ hrī ti mu ka ye/ yaksha raksha hrī ti mu ka ye/ ma ma rā tsa/ u ne u ne hrī ti mañdzu mu ka ya nan/ 'dud cing sde brgyad skor phyag 'tshal// srog 'bul rang la mngon sum ston| |lung rnams mngon sum dag tu ston// gshin rje'i gshed gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las ru khug chen po bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// zhes gsungs pas/ dregs pa rnams rang la 'du ba'i rtags ma mthong gi bar du ru khug gis bcun cing zlog /des kyang mi 'du na dregs pa gang ma 'du ba de ngos bzung la dregs pa rang bsad kyi sbyor ba bsdebs rgyud rnams su gsungs pa gang rung byas pas shin tu 'du ba'i rtags 'byung ngo*// rtags byung nas gtor mas brngan par bya'o// de ltar don 'grub bsnyen pa'i bsdebs de rnams ni grub rtags ma byung na bya bar gsungs shing*/ gzhi bsnyen gyi skabs so so'i bsnyen grangs thems pa'i mthar so so'i bsdebs rnams kyang ci 'grub re bzlas na shin tu legs pa yin la/ ar gtad ni ci tsam bsgrubs kyang grub rtags ma byung na byed pa ma gtogs bsnyen pa'i mthar ched du byar mi rung la/ ru khug kyang dregs pa 'du zhing las la ma tshud pa'i rtags byung na ma gtogs gang rung du byar mi rung bas skabs phyed pa shin tu gal che bar 'dug go// 'di rnams su la'ang ma ston par sbos shig /gang rung su thod la bstan na 'jam dpal gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pas bka' chad drag po thog ltar phob cig
/sa ma ya/ kha thaṃ/ kha thaṃ/ kha thaṃ/ rgya rgya rgya/ zhes pa'ang rje btsun dam pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa'i ljags bsgrigs so// /sarba maṅga laṃ//
